properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_constructor_stores_the_status_it_was_given.rs, in the MCP crate's in_memory program, over the served surface. The class invariant asked of all nine constructors that take `status`: every value the schema allows, on create and on revise (every from/to pair), with and without an approver where the tool takes one — the status stored is the status given, or the call is refused naming why and nothing is written; an approver signature is never drawn on a status the call did not store past the landing one; an approver with no status or with `proposed` is not drawn and the reply says so (approver_not_drawn); an unknown status is refused naming the legal ones and nothing is written; the reported case named (rejected/superseded with an approver land there, and the hint does not say proposed).
properties.findings: 5 passed on branch fix/statuses-and-redraws-keep-what-was-given at 225b20d (cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --no-default-features --test in_memory a_constructor_stores_the_status_it_was_given::), and cargo dev-test green across both crates apart from the two toolsnap goldens the field-text change moved (re-blessed). OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on main 6a45d4b: 5 of 5 (add_decision rejected/superseded stored proposed with and without approver; a revise to proposed over a settled Decision or Requirement ignored; an approver drawn on a proposed node; an unknown Decision status stored proposed). The seven constructors without an approver stored every value already.
properties.name: Every status-taking constructor stores the status it was given (5 MCP tests)
